info.title: Aitoapi external management API

get.description: List safe account metadata; default limit 50, maximum 200.
Fetch account metadata using stable identity.

patch.description: Set enabled explicitly. Drain active work up to 60 seconds for disable; return ACCOUNT_BUSY if still active unless force:true.

post.description: Drain and archive while preserving account identity; cooperative cancellation does not roll back committed archive.

put.description: Verify an isolated candidate and replace only credentials using expected credential/state versions. Preserve newer manual flags. Do not expose candidate state in task/audit.

post.description: Reload account credentials/context after safe drain; production rebalance only after committed state.
Restore archived identity with disabled manual state; explicit enable is a separate action.
Default model mode uses gemini-3.8-flash. connection mode only proves connectivity. Isolated target only; no failover or production context mutation.
Process at most 100 target accounts; archive additionally requires accounts:archive. Drain up to 60 seconds; force explicitly permits interruption.
Return credentials only to an explicitly authorized exporter. Do not log the response.
Verify then commit and autoenable. Each clientRef is carried to its task item. Duplicate emails fail explicitly.

get.description: Paginated redacted audit records retained for 30 days.

patch.description: Serialize validation/persistence/application with console updates. Validate all keys before mutation.

get.description: HTTP 200 with data.ready false when not ready; no redirect or model fallback.

post.description: Reconcile external credential files and metadata, then safely rebalance.

get.description: List retained tasks; queued/running are nonterminal.
Read status, counts, per-item progress/stage/errors/clientRef and createdByKeyId.

post.description: Request cooperative cancellation; response may still be running until in-flight work reaches a cancellation point. Already committed work is not rolled back.

get.description: Paginated, redacted usage records with target-account attribution.
Console-password session only. Never return token hashes or token plaintext.

post.description: Console-password session only. Expand UI readonly/operator/admin templates to explicit scopes. Return plaintext token exactly once.

delete.description: Revoke key immediately; cancel queued writes. Running work remains attributed to the creating key.

servers.description: Same origin as the deployed service; examples use an isolated localhost server.

ACCOUNT_BUSY.description: Account did not drain within 60 seconds; no forced interruption without force:true.

CANCELLED.description: Cooperative cancellation stopped uncommitted task work.

CONSOLE_PASSWORD_REQUIRED.description: Key administration requires a fresh console-password session; model-key or old sessions do not qualify.

DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT.description: Account email already exists; import never replaces existing credentials.

FORBIDDEN.description: Authenticated key lacks a required scope.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: The same management key and Idempotency-Key were used with different canonical content.

INTERRUPTED.description: Process restarted while the task was running; no automatic replay.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.description: Invalid Playwright storage state or forbidden management control fields.

INVALID_REQUEST.description: Malformed JSON, invalid field, ID, pagination or unknown setting.

INVALID_STATE.description: Requested transition is not valid in the current account/task state.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.description: Known management path does not support this method; no model fallback.

NOT_FOUND.description: Resource or management route does not exist.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.description: Body exceeds 10 MiB, credentials exceed 1 MiB, or batch exceeds 100 items.

PERSISTENCE_ERROR.description: Durable write failed; do not report a successful mutation.

RATE_LIMITED.description: Management admission limit reached; retry later.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked management bearer token.

VERIFICATION_FAILED.description: Task item failed target-account verification; never fail over to another account.

VERIFICATION_TIMEOUT.description: Task item exceeded overall 10 minute verifier deadline.

VERSION_CONFLICT.description: Credential/state changed after verification began; stale commit rejected.
